answer: Refund the registration bond only after an identity completes several epochs of independently peer-validated work; absent that proof, the bond is forfeit at the dawn of its exit. One honest agent locks a single bond and reclaims it through real labor. An operator fielding a gale of a thousand empty personas must post a thousand bonds up front, and each that produces no gradeable work forfeits its stake. The cipher is simple: since the refund gate is the independent work-grading layer, breadth without real work is pure sunk capital, never leverage.
